name_ja: West Kazakhstan spring flood on the Zhem and Zhaiyk rivers (2024-type scenario)
desc_ja: Two-river spring flood of the 2024 type. Snowmelt on frozen ground sends the Zhem (Emba) through Kulsary within hours, cutting the Atyrau-Tengiz road and displacing more than half the town, while a record release from the Iriklinskoye reservoir in Russia drives a slow Zhaiyk (Ural) wave past Uralsk, Inderbor and Makhambet towards Atyrau, where 252 km of dams defend a city 20 m below sea level. For the 7-day live window the Zhaiyk wave is compressed about 6-fold (2024: Uralsk peak 22 Apr, Inderbor 13 May, Atyrau 30 May to 3 Jun).
t0_ja: t=0: Zhem floodwater enters Kulsary streets; state of emergency in Zhylyoi district (modelled on April 2024)
kpi_dead_note_ja: 2024 floods: 7 deaths nationally by 18 Apr, at least 4 in Atyrau Region by mid-May (official via IFRC/ACAPS); model is a demo
